shell_text.default: [Player A], you are [personas] until further notice. Speak in your normal voice and take [Penalty, 1] per slip.

closer.default: [Player A], you are no longer [personas].

shell_text.default: [Player A], pick up [accents] and keep it until further notice. Take [Penalty, 1] per slip.

closer.default: [Player A], you can talk normally again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], you only communicate in the sounds [animals] makes until further notice. Use actual words and take [Penalty, 1] per slip.

closer.default: [Player A], you can use real words again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], [speech_constraints] until further notice. Take [Penalty, 1] per slip.

closer.default: [Player A], you can speak freely again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], start every sentence with '[mandatory_openers]' until further notice. Forget it and take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], you can stop saying '[mandatory_openers]'.

shell_text.default: [Player A], [body_effects] until further notice. Take [Penalty, 1] per slip.

closer.default: [Player A], your body's your own again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], [social_restrictions] until further notice. Take [Penalty, 1] per slip.

closer.default: [Player A], you can interact with everyone normally again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], starting now, every time you speak to someone, open with [social_openers]. Forget it and take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], you can stop opening with [social_openers].

shell_text.default: Everyone, give [Player A] a title to go by until further notice. Use their real name or ignore the title and take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], your real name works again.

shell_text.default: Nobody says '[banned_words]' until further notice. Say it and take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: '[banned_words]' is fair game again.

shell_text.default: [Player A]'s name is off-limits until further notice. Say it and take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A]'s name is fair game again.

shell_text.default: Everyone, [group_rules_speech] until further notice. Take [Penalty, 1] per slip.

closer.default: Everyone, the "[group_rules_speech]" rule is lifted.

shell_text.default: Nobody brings up [activefx_banned_topics] until further notice. Mention it and take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: You can bring up [activefx_banned_topics] again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], you own '[trigger_words]' until further notice. Anyone else who says it takes [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], you've lost the rights to '[trigger_words]'.

shell_text.default: Starting now, '[trigger_words]' is the trigger word. Any time someone says it, the last person to [activefx_speaking_cues] takes [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: '[trigger_words]' is just a word again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], starting now, slip '[slip_it_in_words]' into conversation as often as you can. Land it clean and everyone else takes [Penalty, 1]. If the group calls it forced, you take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], you can retire '[slip_it_in_words]'.

shell_text.default: [Player A], check the secret word and slip it in as often as you can. When time's up, everyone else takes [Penalty, 1] per slip. Get caught and you take [Penalty, 3]. Wrong guesses cost [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], time's up. The secret word was '[slip_it_in_secret_words]'. Everyone else takes [Penalty, 1] for every clean slip.

shell_text.default: [Player A], check the secret word and slip it in once before time's up. If you land it, everyone else takes [Penalty, 2-3]. Get caught and you take [Penalty, 4-5]. Wrong guesses cost [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], time's up. The secret word was '[slip_it_in_secret_words]'. If you landed it, everyone else takes [Penalty, 2-3]. If you didn't, you take them.

shell_text.default: [Player A] and [Player B], check the secret word. First to land it without getting caught wins, and everyone else takes [Penalty, 2-3]. Get caught and you take [Penalty, 4-5]. Wrong guesses cost [Penalty, 1].

secret_text.default: [Player A] and [Player B], you share the secret word '[slip_it_in_secret_words]'.

closer.default: [Player A] and [Player B], time's up. The secret word was '[slip_it_in_secret_words]'. If neither landed it, you both take [Penalty, 2].

shell_text.default: [Player A], check the secret word. Bait the group into saying it before time's up, and everyone but you takes [Penalty, 3-4].

secret_text.default: [Player A], the secret word is '[slip_it_in_secret_words]'. Get the group to say it without tipping them off.

closer.default: [Player A], time's up. The secret word was '[slip_it_in_secret_words]'. If anyone said it, everyone but you takes [Penalty, 3-4]. If not, you take them.

shell_text.default: [Player A], check the secret line and work it into conversation before time's up. If you land it, everyone else takes [Penalty, 2-3]. Get caught and you take [Penalty, 4-5]. Wrong guesses cost [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], time's up. The secret line was "[slip_it_in_phrases]". If you didn't land it, take [Penalty, 2].

shell_text.default: Starting now, before anyone takes a penalty, they must [activefx_rituals]. Forget it and the penalty doubles.

closer.default: Everyone, penalties go straight through again.

shell_text.default: Everyone, [activefx_speaking_cues] before you speak until further notice. Forget it and take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: Everyone, no more cue before you speak.

shell_text.default: [Player A], starting now, every time someone says your name, answer with '[activefx_catchphrases]'. Miss it and take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], you can stop saying '[activefx_catchphrases]'.

shell_text.default: [Player A], starting now, every time you say a sentence, put air quotes around one of the words. Forget it and take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], you can drop the air quotes.

shell_text.default: [Player A], starting now, [penalty_ceremonies] before every penalty you take. Forget and the penalty doubles.

closer.default: [Player A], you can take your penalties normally again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], [suppression_targets] until further notice. Take [Penalty, 1] per slip. Everyone else, make it hard.

closer.default: [Player A], the "[suppression_targets]" rule is lifted.

shell_text.default: Everyone, [group_rules_conduct] until further notice. Catch a slip and everyone but you takes [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: Everyone, the "[group_rules_conduct]" rule is lifted.

shell_text.default: [Player A], check your secret habit and start doing it. First to guess it gives out [Penalty, max]. Wrong guesses cost [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], time's up. The secret habit was [activefx_habits]. If nobody guessed it, take [Penalty, 3].

shell_text.default: [Player A], tell one lie in conversation before time's up. Get caught and take [Penalty, 2]. Anyone who accuses you wrongly takes [Penalty, 2]. If nobody catches it, give out [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: Time's up, [Player A]. Own the lie, and if it slid past everyone, give out [Penalty, 2].

shell_text.default: [Player A], every penalty you take is doubled until further notice.

closer.default: [Player A], your penalties are no longer doubled.

shell_text.default: [Player A], starting now, every penalty you take is halved, rounded up.

closer.default: [Player A], your penalties count in full again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], every penalty you give out is doubled until further notice.

closer.default: [Player A], the penalties you give out are no longer doubled.

shell_text.default: [Player A], starting now, the person on your [vw_direction] takes your penalties.

closer.default: [Player A], your penalties are yours again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], starting now, [Player B] takes your penalties.

closer.default: [Player A], your penalties are yours again. [Player B], you're off the hook.

shell_text.default: [Player A] and [Player B], you are now mated. Whenever one of you takes a penalty, so does the other.

closer.default: [Player A] and [Player B], it's over between you two. Your penalties are your own again.

shell_text.default: Starting now, nobody takes a penalty alone. Everyone must take [Penalty, 1] with them.

closer.default: Everyone, you're back to taking penalties alone.

shell_text.default: Starting now, whenever anyone takes a penalty, they pick one other person to drag down with them. That person takes the same penalty.

closer.default: No more dragging people down with you.

shell_text.default: Starting now, all penalties go into a pot. Keep a tally. When the pot closes, one lucky player takes them all.

closer.default: Congratulations, [Player A], the pot's all yours.

shell_text.default: [Player A], any penalty you give out is at least [Penalty, 3] until further notice, no matter what the prompt says.

closer.default: [Player A], give out whatever the prompt says again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], you're cursed until further notice. Every penalty you take is doubled. The moment you [transfer_triggers], the curse passes to them.

closer.default: The curse burns out. Whoever's holding it takes [Penalty, 2-3].

shell_text.default: [Player A], you're holding the hot potato. To pass it, [transfer_triggers]. Whoever falls for it takes [Penalty, 1] and holds it next. Whoever's holding it at the end takes [Penalty, 4].

closer.default: Time's up. Whoever's holding the hot potato takes [Penalty, 4].

shell_text.default: [Player A], [escalating_constraints] until further notice. First slip costs [Penalty, 1]. Second costs [Penalty, 2]. Every one after that costs [Penalty, 3].

closer.default: [Player A], you're back to normal.

shell_text.default: [Player A], don't take your penalties until further notice. Keep a running tally instead and wait for instructions.

closer.default: [Player A], [activefx_bank_payouts].

shell_text.default: All penalties are doubled until further notice.

closer.default: All penalties are back to normal.

shell_text.default: Starting now, every penalty is at least [Penalty, 3] no matter what.

closer.default: The minimum is lifted. Penalties are back to whatever they were.

shell_text.default: [Player A] and [Player B], starting now, pick up [accents] and keep it. Either of you slips and you both take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A] and [Player B], you can talk normally again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], starting now, talk [activefx_opposite_styles.a]. [Player B], talk [activefx_opposite_styles.b]. Either of you slips and you both take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A] and [Player B], you can talk normally again.

shell_text.default: [Player A] and [Player B], no laughing until further notice. If either of you laughs, you both take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A] and [Player B], laugh all you want now.

shell_text.default: [Player B], echo the last word of every sentence [Player A] says until further notice. Miss one and you both take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player B], you're done echoing [Player A].

shell_text.default: Starting now, you're all [personas]. Anyone who breaks character takes [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: You can all stop being [personas].

shell_text.default: Starting now, everyone talks in [accents]. Anyone who slips back to their normal voice takes [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: You can all talk normally again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], mirror every move [Player B] makes until further notice. If the group catches you out of sync, take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], you can stop mirroring [Player B].

shell_text.default: [Player A], you're anchored to [Player B] until further notice. Every penalty they take, you take too.

closer.default: [Player A], you're cut loose from [Player B].

shell_text.default: [Player A], you're immune from taking penalties until further notice.

closer.default: [Player A], immunity's up. Take [Penalty, 2] for the free ride.

shell_text.default: [Player A], [speech_constraints] until further notice. Slip once and take [Penalty, 3].

closer.default: [Player A], time's up. If you never slipped, give out [Penalty, 2].

shell_text.default: [Player A], starting now, you're immune from [specific_immunities]. Everything else still counts.

closer.default: [Player A], you're no longer immune.

shell_text.default: Everyone, [group_rules] until further notice. The first slip in the group costs [Penalty, 1]. The second costs [Penalty, 2]. Every one after that costs [Penalty, 3].

closer.default: Everyone, the "[group_rules]" rule is lifted.

shell_text.default: [Player A], [degen_drink_rules] until further notice. Break it and take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], drink however you want again.

shell_text.default: Buffalo rules until further notice. Drink only with your non-dominant hand. Catch someone drinking with their dominant hand and yell 'Buffalo!' They finish their drink. Call it wrong and you finish yours.

how_to_play.default: Drink only with your non-dominant hand, so your left if you're right-handed. If you spot someone drinking with their dominant hand, yell 'Buffalo!' and they finish their drink. Yell it at someone who was using their non-dominant hand and you finish yours.

closer.default: Buffalo's off. Drink with either hand.

shell_text.default: [Player A], you are now the Thumb Master. Whenever you quietly put your thumb on something, everyone copies you. Last one to copy takes [Penalty, 1].

how_to_play.default: The Thumb Master can quietly put a thumb on something, like a wall or their knee, at any moment and as often as they like. When you notice, put your thumb on something too. The last one to copy takes the penalty.

closer.default: [Player A], you're no longer the Thumb Master.

shell_text.default: [Player A], you are now the Freeze Master. Whenever you freeze without a word, everyone freezes too. Last one still moving takes [Penalty, 1].

how_to_play.default: The Freeze Master can freeze in place without a word at any moment, as often as they like. When you notice, freeze too. The last one still moving takes the penalty.

closer.default: [Player A], you're no longer the Freeze Master. Everyone can thaw out.

shell_text.default: [Player A], you are now the Grenade Master. Whenever you yell 'Grenade', everyone ducks or takes cover. Last one to react takes [Penalty, 1].

how_to_play.default: The Grenade Master can yell 'Grenade' at any moment, as often as they like. When they do, duck or take cover as fast as you can. The last one to react takes the penalty.

closer.default: [Player A], you're out of grenades.

shell_text.default: [Player A], you are now the Question Master. Anyone who answers one of your questions takes [Penalty, 1]. The only safe answer is another question.

how_to_play.default: Anyone who answers a question from the Question Master takes the penalty, so watch for questions slipped into normal conversation. The only safe answer is a question of your own.

closer.default: [Player A], you're no longer the Question Master. Any questions?

shell_text.default: Starting now, anyone drinking from a can is in the Game of Life. Keep your tab crooked. Get caught with a straight tab and finish your drink.

how_to_play.default: If you're drinking from a can, twist the tab to the side so it isn't straight, and do the same with every can you open. Anyone who spots a straight tab can call it, and whoever it belongs to finishes their drink. Once you're in, you're in for life.

closer.default: Good news, the Game of Life wasn't for life after all. You can straighten your tabs.

shell_text.default: Everyone, a little green man sits on your drink until further notice. Take him off before you drink and put him back after. Forget him and take [Penalty, 1].

how_to_play.default: Pretend a little green man sits on top of your drink. Before you drink, lift him off and set him down, then put him back on top when you're done. Anyone who catches you forgetting can call it, and you take the penalty.

closer.default: Everyone, your little green men have gone home. Drink however you want.

shell_text.default: [Player A], pick a bodyguard. Starting now, any penalty aimed at you hits them instead.

closer.default: [Player A], your bodyguard's off duty. Your penalties are yours again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], put a bounty on someone. Starting now, every penalty they take, you give out the same amount to anyone you want.

closer.default: [Player A], the bounty's lifted. You're done cashing in.

shell_text.default: [Player A], you don't speak at all until further notice. Break the silence and take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player A], you can talk again.

shell_text.default: [Player A] and [Player B], swap positions. No going back.

closer.default: [Player A] and [Player B], you can swap back now. If either of you already did, you both take [Penalty, max].
